{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''relief effort''' was organized for [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Ace]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Nozzo Naytaan]] led the effort's relief fleet.<ref name="CCGR9">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Red 9}}</ref><ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
